Sad its being review bombed when it has nothing to do with gta 6.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: SpaceSoup
quote:
20fps in 26 is pretty bad for the most anticipated game. Its filled with bugs, no mission replay, cant play it like other gta titles, no carnage, no fun destruction due to the honour system and once that gets too high your stuck in getting a bad ending with no way back. 
A positive is the graphics are absolutely stunning.
